item.title: OpenAI launches enterprise agent platform with usage-based pricing (4 minute read)
item.description: OpenAI announced general availability of its enterprise agent platform, letting companies deploy agents with SSO, audit logs and per-seat pricing. Early customers include banks in the UAE and Saudi Arabia.
